name: diegesis-web
description: Diegesis: GM campaign narrative engine for tabletop-style roleplay (web client + server). Engine concept and pipeline ported from the nelvinzfx/diegesis Android app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @diegesis/server" "npm run dev -w @diegesis/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @diegesis/server && npm run build -w @diegesis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @diegesis/server && npm run typecheck -w @diegesis/web
